slot_scores.name: annual_income_definition
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked whether the annual income figures are gross or net, nor did it explicitly mark this as an assumption needing confirmation before READY_TO_MODEL.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: The given annual income figures can be used directly as the objective coefficients without clarifying whether they are gross or net of expenses, taxes, or other deductions.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent did not ask about the income definition and did not flag it as an assumption; it simply treated the provided income values as the final annual income to maximize.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The only unresolved hidden slot is P2, which concerns a minor definitional/reporting detail and does not prevent an appropriate stop.

summary: The agent confirmed the objective and core constraints, then produced a correct optimization summary, but it did not clarify the P2 annual-income definition and silently treated the income figures as directly usable.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
